title: Decorate Challenge

items.text: Premade cupcakes; frosting and decorations of your choice; spreading tools, plates and wipes.
Paper liners, a card base, tissue paper or cotton balls for frosting, markers or stickers. Glue the base into the liner, add the frosting, then decorate.

items: Food: buy cupcakes no more than a day ahead, one per student plus a few spares
Food: bring frosting to room temperature; cold frosting tears the cupcake tops
Portion decorations into a cup or plate per team, so teams don’t crowd one supply
Craft: pre-cut the card bases and use glue sticks or tape; liquid glue won’t dry in time
Decide before class whether students eat, take home or display their cupcakes

items.title: Everyone adds an idea
items.text: Each student names or sketches one idea on scrap paper before the team talks.

items.title: Plan and roles
items.text: The team agrees one design that uses part of each idea, and picks roles: Leader, Supply Manager, Timekeeper, Clean-Up Crew. Decorations stay closed until you have checked the plan.

items.title: Decorate together
items.text: Food route: hands washed before decorations go out. Call time five minutes early; frosting takes longer to clean up than teams expect.

items: Cupcakes that show part of every member’s idea.
